# User experience

<!-- mirage:section basis -->
## Design basis

No designs exist yet; the app follows platform conventions (Q-007).

<!-- mirage:section inventory -->
## Screen inventory

Booking, my bookings and settings are the only screens in v1.0.

<!-- mirage:section flows -->
## Flows

Book a slot: pick a service, pick a slot, confirm with a one-time code.

<!-- mirage:section navigation -->
## Navigation map

A bottom bar switches between booking and my bookings.

<!-- mirage:section links -->
## Links and deep links

A reminder notification opens the booking it mentions.

<!-- mirage:section accessibility -->
## Accessibility

Every screen meets WCAG 2.2 AA.

<!-- mirage:section responsive -->
## Responsive and platform rules

Phones in portrait only; tablets show the phone layout.
